issues.description: The problem statement explicitly instructs students to call setup_env() with no parameters (problem_statement.md lines 21-22). The solution implementation, however, calls setup_env after pushing a single argument (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm: push 1; call setup_env), which contradicts the specified no-parameter signature. In addition, the template does not declare extern setup_env (template_repository/helloWorld.asm declares extern printf but not extern setup_env), so students who follow the problem text and add a call to setup_env() may be unsure whether and how to declare the external symbol. Together these differences (solution using one parameter, template lacking an extern declaration while the problem asks for a no-arg call) create confusion about the intended signature and the correct way to reference the environment helper.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the signature and usage of setup_env consistent across all artifacts. Options: (A) If setup_env takes no parameters (as the problem states), update the solution to remove the pushed argument (remove 'push 1') and keep 'extern setup_env' if needed; and add 'extern setup_env' to the template so students know how to reference it. OR (B) If setup_env really requires one parameter, update the problem statement to document the required parameter and calling convention, and adjust the template to declare 'extern setup_env' so students can follow the intended calling pattern.
